title: review: Fix: interference.graph_fresh_for treats an empty path list as fresh instead of diffing the whole repo
spec:
Goal T-0503 polish from review T-0530 (low). Base goal/T-0503 (S4a T-0508 merged). Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only. Tests are unittest.TestCase methods.
Finding: interference.graph_fresh_for(paths, graph, git=None) runs `git diff --name-only <built_at_commit> HEAD -- <paths>`; when a task pair has no literal or glob-matched files (directory-only scopes) the pathspec is empty and git diffs the whole repository, which reports stale for any commit since the build. Fix: when the resolved path list is empty return True (vacuously fresh, nothing of the pair's surface can have changed) without invoking git; graph_signal then proceeds to the link lookup, which finds no files and returns [] as before. Test tests/test_interference.py::test_graph_fresh_for_empty_paths_is_fresh_without_git (an injected git callable that raises if called; result True). Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: tests/test_interference.py::test_graph_fresh_for_empty_paths_is_fresh_without_git passes: graph_fresh_for([], graph, git=raising_callable) returns True and never calls git
existing interference tests stay green; full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 and the suite gains one test
